messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a rear-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands still, facing away from the camera and looking out toward the water.","camera":"The camera is positioned behind the person at a low angle, slowly pushing in to a medium close-up of their upper back and head.","clothing":"The person is wearing a matching two-piece outfit, consisting of a long-sleeved jacket and trousers, in a brown and orange plaid pattern.","hair_color":"The hair appears dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"The person's hair is pulled up into a high top-knot or bun.","identity":"A person with a slim build is seen from behind, with their face not visible.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor stone terrace or pier overlooking a calm body of water under a clear, bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins from behind the person in a full-body rear view near the water and slowly dollies in to an upper-body/medium close-up of the back and head. The person remains in the same plaid suit and top-knot, and the outdoor waterfront scene is retained. The person is now standing still facing away rather than performing the source's walking/turning progression.
arguments.requested_change: Switch only the camera to a rear-view dolly-in from full-body to upper-body framing, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing while preserving the person's appearance, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the exact timing and progression of the source action were preserved, because the visible action changed to standing still.
unexpected_changes: The source walking and turning action was replaced by a static standing pose facing away from the camera.
